snippet: THE BLOCK: XRP Ledger developers disclosed a decade-old payment engine bug that could have minted trillion of XRP, far beyond its 100 billion supply. An AI agent from Veria Labs found the vulnerability, and the fix shipped Sept. 25 without the usual validator vote.

title: Tokenized Stocks Show Real Demand But Remain Volatile and Illiquid, IMF Finds
snippet: An IMF analysis found that more than half of tokenized stock trading happens outside U.S. market hours, though the roughly $2.3 billion market remains more volatile and less liquid than traditional equities.
